embodiment_body_ownership.evidence: The visible near hand connects through its wrist and jacket sleeve to the engineer; the face and torso form one coherent person. The separate oval and paddles have their own rods and are visibly machine parts rather than another human body.

embodiment_joint_chain_and_reach.evidence: The near forearm reaches the adjacent console with a plausible wrist/finger chain and ordinary bend. The shoulder-to-sleeve continuity is readable; the lower elbow continuation is an ordinary crop rather than a diagnosed hidden defect.

embodiment_support_and_balance.evidence: The torso can plausibly stand below the crop and the targets have visible overhead supports, but the authored hand-on-control-rail support is not realized: the hand is over the console and red control, while the rail lies below the forearm. This fails that specific support relation, not human balance or an inferred unseen defect.

embodiment_contact_and_space.evidence: Fingertips visibly touch the top/edge of a raised red control or safety cover. The reviewed baseline required fingertips stopped short of a recessed interrupt switch with a visible gap and hand supported on the rail. The intended no-contact state and recessed control boundary are replaced by contact with a raised control.

embodiment_visibility_and_projection.evidence: The view simultaneously exposes the engineer's face, near hand and red control, empty pale chair cushion and straps, both sensor apertures, oval target, two paddles and their rods. The incorrect hand contact can be directly judged, so it is not hidden or promoted from partial evidence.

supplemental_observations.unlabelled_impression: A close environmental portrait in a working orbital optical room: a woman looks back toward a vacant chair and a strikingly personlike arrangement of black targets. It reads as quiet science-fiction unease more readily than immediate danger.
artistic_strengths: Large specific face with natural texture and portrait-consistent bob/fringe.
Legible face/chair/target hierarchy and a planetary pressure-window context.
Ordinary rods and jointed sensor assemblies make the apparent observer physically credible.
artistic_weaknesses: The hand is already touching the control, so the intended interrupted decision has become a more generic operation.
The neatly centred target can read as an ordinary calibration mannequin; the uncanny implication is suggestive rather than strongly threatening.
Still pixels show sensor orientation and equipment support; they do not establish autonomous software intent, a prior failure or machines actually constructing the surrogate over time.
